name: Visor: T3 Code
description:
Requires Visor. Shows the agent sessions of T3 Code in the notch: what works, what finished and what waits for you. Approvals are answered right in the row, and the command "t3" in the search sends a message to the last thread.

Network: only the T3 Code server you pair it with. The access token is kept in the keyring. No telemetry.
